meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可以调用你电脑上 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里的本地模型。它仍是总指挥,但能通过“列出模型”和“向指定模型发提示词”这两个新工具,把部分任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 使用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型来回答问题或生成内容时,它会从列出可用模型开始,再调用指定模型。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再选一个回答。

say.text: 列出当前 Atomic Chat 可用的模型
用 llama3.2-3b-instruct 模型回答:什么是黑洞?
say.note: 指定模型后调用生成工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can invoke local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app. It stays the orchestrator but can offload tasks to local models via two new tools: listing models and sending prompts to a specified model.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to use Atomic Chat or a local model for a question or generation, it starts by listing available models, then calls the chosen one.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models and picks one to answer.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat
Using the llama3.2-3b-instruct model, answer: What is a black hole?
say_en.note: Calls the generation tool with a specified model.
